title: Taiwan · Taroko Gorge and East Coast
slogan: A 131 km loop out of Taroko Gorge
story: Marble canyon, high road and weather risk. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 52 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Taroko Gorge gate, Hehuanshan high road, Qixingtan beach, while the fuel checkpoint and Tianxiang keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Taiwan Central Cross Island Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 33 km this is Taiwan Central Cross Island Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Yangmingshan → Jinshan coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 16 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
